verdict.rationale: cubic exposes meaningful programmatic surfaces: an MCP server that reads findings and codebase docs, requests PR reviews, and triages PR and codebase-scan issues. MCP also covers subscription, seat and role management, alongside a read-only Analytics API, a CLI, and cubic.yaml config-as-code. That falls well short of evidenced full UI parity, though: no general REST API or OpenAPI spec was found, and several UI actions have no documented API path. missing for 10: a documented general-purpose API with parity claims, an OpenAPI spec, API coverage for UI actions like Fix with cubic, wiki, custom-agent library adoption, flex-capacity and integration settings, independent corroboration.
